# Project CEDAR Escalation Operations

## CEDAR Scope
Project CEDAR escalation threshold governance applies to operational exception handling and response-time review.

## CEDAR Ownership
Project CEDAR escalation threshold ownership remains with the service assurance lead and the regional operations controller.

## CEDAR Review Cadence
Project CEDAR escalation threshold performance is reviewed each week against the approved operating model.

## CEDAR Notification Path
Project CEDAR escalation threshold notifications are routed through the standard service assurance workflow.

## CEDAR Evidence Rule
Project CEDAR escalation threshold exceptions require documented evidence before an escalation is closed.

## CEDAR Escalation Threshold
The Project CEDAR escalation threshold is governed by the immediately following approved parameter note. Use that adjacent note for the controlling value.

## Approved Parameter
The approved interval is 47 minutes.

## Regional Maintenance
The regional maintenance window is 90 minutes and is unrelated to the Project CEDAR escalation threshold.

## CEDAR Audit
Project CEDAR escalation threshold audit records must retain the decision trail and approver identity.

## CEDAR Closure
Project CEDAR escalation threshold closure requires confirmation that the applicable operating parameter was followed.
